author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be Wolverine which might be the most patronizing superhero cinematic Sony game I've seen in a while. This game will not often play itself and serve to guide you quite literally between cutscenes asking once again why someone would buy a game that basically plays itself, when so many other options exist. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Wolverine Is Pure Playstation Slop...
